text_block_list.text:
Having successfully run through those vital "first three years"
and achieved splendid results in the Twinkle Series,
Admire Vega—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Bwahahahahaha!!
Now, take as many pictures of me as your heart desires!
Come, come, come, come!!

text_block_list.name: Cameraman
text_block_list.text:
E-Excuse me, Opera O-san, if you could do a slightly
more subdued pose...!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Hyawawawawawawa!!
P-P-Pleashed to make your acquaintance...!

text_block_list.name: Cameraman
text_block_list.text:
Doto-san, your eyes! Your eyes!
I haven't even used the flash yet, so if you could please open your eyes...!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Is a pose like this alright?
Well then, I look forward to working with you!

text_block_list.name: Cameraman
text_block_list.text:
Hai-ee!! It's perfect...!!
Thank you so much!!

—We were being interviewed for an article titled
"Fierce Battle! Four-Way Rivalry Feature."

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Alright, and last but not least, Admire Vega-san,
you're up!

text_block_list.name: Cameraman
text_block_list.text: "We'll be filming throughout the interview, but please don't worry about the cameras and just relax as you speak."

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Understood.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Howawaa... Ayabe-san, you're surrounded by
cameras but you look so sharp and composed.
You're so amazing...!!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, playing a cool character for once... might not be so bad after all.
Ah, inspiration is striking me!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
H-Hey, both of you! Ayabe-san is
in the middle of an interview,
so please keep it down...!

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha! What a lovely atmosphere.
Are the four of you usually this close?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: No, not particularly.

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Oh, is that right!
Do the four of you hang out together in your daily academy life too...?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Hardly ever.
To begin with, Opera O and Doto are in a different grade than me.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Top Road-san is in the same class, so we just happen to talk a bit more often because of that.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: I am usually alone.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...It's just that, in races,
they wouldn't leave me alone.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: And... because I wasn't alone, there was a battle I could fight.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Yes, that's what I believe.
And so, a few days later—

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...How long are you going to keep staring?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Training.
Let's get started soon.
—My days with Admire Vega continue.
